text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart and I decided to stop by a 
diner and take a break before heading 
back.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll go with cherry soda♪ Trainer, 
have you decided what you're having?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Is that— Hi, Heart-san!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Crown and King-san! That espresso 
looks delicious♪ Maybe I'll order one too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I recommend it. It's a rich 
ristretto, so I think it pairs wonderfully 
with biscotti♪

And so, I decided to enjoy some tea 
together with them, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Heart-san, how was the cheer choreography 
this time? Did you like it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course♪ I especially loved that 
choreography!
(TA-DAAAAH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Yes, this choreography!

The moment Daring Heart spun around, the 
store's background music coincidentally 
shifted into something flashy.

"Multiplying footsteps, echoing voices, 
sparkling lights— As if the stage curtain 
had just been raised, the scene began to 
glow with brilliance—!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry to interrupt while you're 
talking. Crown, I came to drop off 
something you left behind.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Huh? Duramente-san! Oh, goodness me... 
I'm so sorry, and thank you!

Duramente, the highly gifted daughter of a 
prestigious family. Satono Crown, positive 
and affable.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King-saaan! Good day to you~~! The tea the 
other day was absolutely delicious~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you like it? Well, naturally, it is 
tea chosen by a first-class King, after 
all♪

King Halo, dazzling and trusted by all. 
Kawakami Princess, who idolizes her. —If 
this were a story, they would be 
captivating characters.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! It's getting pretty lively around 
here♪"

And here, too, is a captivating heroine. 
...I wonder if there is a role for me to 
play in this story?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right, Trainer. Could you give 
me your thoughts on the choreography too?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I feel like the overall structure is still 
a bit rough around the edges... What do 
you think?

Setting the roles aside for now—let's go 
over the choreography video. I need to 
check all the data, from the number of 
cheerleaders to the stage dimensions.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? You've got a good look on your 
face, Trainer. Did you come up with 
something?"
choice_data_list:
...The key must be how it relates to the 
box's size.

...The key might be how it relates to the 
box's size.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The size of the box... —Ah, you mean the 
scale of the venue?
choice_data_list:
It's a small venue this time. We can't do 
a big formation.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Right. We're pretty tight on hands, so I 
think the size will have to be limited.
choice_data_list:
So larger movements are fine. Even if 
they're a bit rough around the edges.

text_block_list.text:
As I focused on what was right in front of 
me, I started to see my role little by 
little... and felt like I was really 
blending into the story—!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! Since the formation is small, 
you guarantee a sense of scale through 
larger movements, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's a great idea! You're so 
clever♪
choice_data_list:
Heh, leave this kinda stuff to guys like 
us.

Heh, leave this kinda stuff to people like 
us.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow...! Fufu, there's a sparkle deep in 
your eyes♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help overhearing that! That's a 
wonderful idea. I'd love to put it into 
practice right away♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, me too! Oh, I know—let's step outside 
the shop right now and—

text_block_list.name: Diner Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Go ahead, you can dance here! 
We're just about to close up shop 
anywayâ

text_block_list.name: Diner Owner
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how much fun you're having gives me 
energy too! Alright—hit the music!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much! Then without further 
ado—start the music!♪"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Whew~~♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yeah～～～！！

Surrounded by cheerful music and lively 
chatter, the sun slowly went down.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—I wonder if I've ever seen you make a 
face like that before? Hehe, I guess I got 
to experience something quite rare♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It just surprised me a little, 
that's all♪ Now come on over here, let's 
dance even more!
choice_data_list:
Wait... I think I'm starting to get 
scared.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! It just surprised me a little, 
that's all♪ Now come on over here, let's 
dance even more!
choice_data_list:
Wait... I think I'm starting to get 
scared.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first, put both hands up— Say, 
"Whoa!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, nice voice! Can you make it just a 
little louder? Say, 'Whoa!'"

"When you really think about it, this 
place is ridiculously cheerful... Truly, 
ridiculously so――"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What? Hehe, getting nervous only now? 
Don't worry, nobody's paying it any mind.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If you're still nervous even after 
that—well, I'd love to see that look on 
your face again. The cool and clever one, 
that is♪
